Name: Jerioth
Summary: Wife of Caleb son of Hezron, named alongside Azubah.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 2:18: Wife of Caleb son of Hezron, named alongside Azubah.
LifeLesson: The mention of Jerioth in 1 Chronicles places this person within the story of God's people under David and his kingdom.
